title: Relevant restriction indices lie in the dependency set
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, and let $J,P$ be subsets of the coordinate indices. Fix signs on $P$ and consider the restriction of $f$ obtained by varying the remaining coordinates. If $f$ depends only on coordinates in $J$, and changing the free coordinate $i\notin P$ can change this restricted function while all other free coordinates are held fixed, then $i\in J$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the Boolean cube
$J,P$ are subsets of the coordinate indices
a sign assignment is fixed on $P$
the free index $i$ is relevant to the restricted function
